headlines.text: Looking back to 2021, when history was made as Jon Moxley vs. Yuji Nagata contested the very first IWGP United States Title match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.07 ? a well-worked match. Nagata's first American TV appearance in nearly 23 years ? Moxley debuted new "Wild Thing" entrance music for the occasion, and the two shared a genuine moment of mutual respect afterward, celebrating a career and a wrestling style that had largely gone out of style.
2023 brought us this moment: Brian Cage made their return to AEW television after just over 3 months away, appearing on Rampage.

Rewind to 2021, when gold changed shoulders as the AEW TNT Title found a new champion as Miro vs. Darby Allin battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.64 ? a solid showing ? ending the champion's reign at 9 defenses. Miro was challenging for gold for the very first time. Darby Allin was chasing gold for the 10th time. The end of a record-setting reign ? Miro's brutal pre-bell beatdown set the tone, but Allin fought back with real heart before finally submitting to the Game Over, ending his 186-day championship run and delivering an emotional, tearful farewell speech afterward.
